scenes.title: OpenAI Codex
scenes.sub: OpenAI's software engineering agent, the developer-side counterpart to Claude Code.
scenes.say: This is OpenAI Codex, OpenAI's software engineering agent.

scenes.heading: What it is
bullets: Works locally or in cloud sandboxes
The developer-side counterpart to Claude Code
scenes.say: Codex writes and tests code, either on your machine or in cloud sandboxes, and opens pull requests when it's done. It's the developer-side counterpart to Claude Code.

scenes.heading: How it runs
steps: CLI, IDE extension, or desktop app
OpenAI models, such as GPT-6 Astra
scenes.say: Run it locally as a command line tool, an IDE extension, or a desktop app, or hand off cloud tasks that run in OpenAI's sandboxes. It runs on OpenAI models such as GPT-6 Astra.

scenes.heading: Timeline
scenes.say: The open-source Codex CLI came out in April 2025, and the Codex cloud agent arrived in ChatGPT that May. The latest stable CLI is 0.162.1, from October 9, 2026.
